story: Care -> observe -> build -> apply -> return to the farm. Hens, ducks, goats and rabbits alternate with care and mapping views. Outdoor rovers, wheel details and a robotic mower on grass and paving make movement tangible. The 4-H project-ideas verse links animal observation, DIY planning, hands-on robotics and circuit work. Harvesting brings the story back to people and land before the application invitation. Stock illustrates these ideas; it is not Tender Cells hardware, customer footage, or an affiliated 4-H program.
